clusters.pick_reason: Both patches touch the same Accept-header validation branch and fix the identical 406 rejection, but #1996 implements a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that correctly handles q=0 (explicitly rejected media types) and wildcard subtypes/types per RFC 7231, whereas #2046's fix uses a plain substring `includes('application/json')` check that would incorrectly accept an Accept header like 'application/json;q=0' or fail to recognize 'application/*' style wildcards. #1996's helper is also unit-testable in isolation and doesn't inline parsing logic into the request handler.
